audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 2, 3, 4-5 and Level 6 disagreed with their own whys: the chart gave Yone Level 3 while whys[2] reads "Level 3 stays Kennen's", gave Yone 4-5 while whys[3] reads "skill-based", and gave Kennen Level 6 while whys[4] reads "even".
audit.why: The packet chart reads Kennen, Kennen, Kennen, Skill, Skill, Yone, Yone and the mirror audit also puts Kennen on rows 2 and 3. Kennen out-ranges Yone by 500 units at level 2-3 and there is no version of that lane Yone wins.
audit.corrected: Flipped rows 1 and 2 to Kennen and rows 3 and 4 to Skill on BOTH layers as one group, and rewrote those four phase whys.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why said "Kennen's ultimate changes the math too" with no number, and no cooldown appeared anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Slicing Maelstrom is a flat 120s at every rank — identical to Fate Sealed at rank 1. That symmetry is the level-6 decision: whoever spends first loses the rematch.
audit.corrected: Stated 120s for both ultimates in phases[4].why and breakdown.cooldowns, and added Lightning Rush's 10/9/8/7/6 to the tracking lines.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page told the player to track Lightning Rush as "his escape" but never explained Mark of the Storm, and described Spirit Cleave as sustain that "heals through his poke" in two content fields.
audit.why: Riot's passive text: "Kennen stuns enemies he hits 3 times with his abilities." Q, W and E each apply a mark, so the stun is the thing to count, not the escape. And Yone's W "Grants a shield" — it has no heal at all, which changes whether you can trade through chip.
audit.corrected: Put the three-mark stun into report[5].t and the trade lines, and replaced 'Cleave sustain heals' with the shield in spikes[2].text and late.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].t reads "Build MR" but its body text was the generic trading line — the page never said why.
audit.why: Electrical Surge applies on-hit and scales with his attack speed (Lightning Rush grants attack speed on exit), so his damage is entirely magic and armour reads the trade wrong.
audit.corrected: Rewrote dosFull[1].d around Electrical Surge's on-hit magic damage and Mercury's Treads.

edits.after: Kennen is all magic — Electrical Surge adds on-hit marks, so Mercury's Treads and MR beat armour in every trade.

edits.before: Q stacking and passive crits win the short trades. Respect Kennen's Lightning Rush completely — the first levels are about banking small advantages, not proving a point.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are his: 950-range shuriken poke and marks stacking toward the stun. Farm behind minions, break line of sight, and never trade with two marks already on you.

edits.before: First-item Yone starts flipping this — your Q3 gap-close and Cleave sustain heal through his poke, and if he's used W stacks or R you kill him. Force the all-in when his stun engine is on cooldown.
edits.after: First-item Yone starts flipping this — your Q3 gap-close and Spirit Cleave's shield absorb his poke, and if he has spent Electrical Surge or R you kill him. Force the all-in once the marks on you have expired.

edits.before: From first item on the matchup swings to you — gap-close past his poke with Q3, outheal the chip with Cleave, and kill him once his R is down. At 2+ items you cleanly win the 1v1; just avoid grouped fights where his AoE R shines and take him in the sidelane instead.
edits.after: From first item on the matchup swings to you — gap-close past his poke with Q3, eat the chip on Spirit Cleave's shield, and kill him in the 120s his R is down. At 2+ items you cleanly win the 1v1; avoid grouped fights where his AoE R shines and take him in the sidelane instead.
